purpose: Teach: あめ/サヨナラ/ミーハー/ひとみ/られよ/スキップ/バツ/下敷き

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがあめ細工を作って下さったわよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad made you some candy craft.
lines.style: Warm, pleased announcement. Bright opening. She's delighted to share this with him. Clear, unhurried pace. The tone of a mother offering something she knows will make him happy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが「サヨナラはまた会う約束」って仰ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad said something about 'farewells are promises to meet again.'
lines.style: Soft, thoughtful delivery. Small voice — he's turning something over in his mind. Slight pause before the quote, like he's being careful to get it right. Wonder underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ミーハーな話題ばかりじゃダメよ
lines.en: Sho, you can't just talk about light things all the time.
lines.style: Gentle correction, not harsh. Warm but steady. She's guiding him toward something deeper. Slight emphasis on 'just,' not scolding — encouraging him to think bigger.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんのひとみが優しいよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's eyes are really kind.
lines.style: Hushed, almost wondering. He's noticing something true and offering it carefully. Soft focus in the voice, like he's sharing an observation that matters to him. No performance — just seeing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんに「がんばられよ」と言われたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad told me to 'keep giving my best effort.'
lines.style: Reflective, slightly moved. She's holding onto what he said. Slower pace on the phrase — it lands. Warmth underneath, like she's thinking about him hearing those words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、スキップしながら歩いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I walked the whole way skipping.
lines.style: Bright, eager small voice. The joy is in the telling. Quick, light pace. He's proud of this small happiness. Opening attack is cheerful — he's sharing something that made him feel good.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、宿題でバツが付かないようにね
lines.en: Sho, make sure you don't get any X marks on your homework.
lines.style: Practical, caring instruction. Light touch — not worried, just reminding. Clear, mother-to-child. The tone of someone who notices his efforts and wants him to succeed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本に下敷きを敷いて書いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I put a ruler under the book so I could write better.
lines.style: Earnest and proud. He's showing her he listened, he tried. Soft but steady — this matters to him. Small pause after 'ruler,' like he's checking if she notices he did the right thing.
